system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS Advanced mathematics test for students in the twelfth grade, the final year of secondary school, who have taken advanced mathematics courses. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: Graph of y = f(x)]

This figure shows the graph of y = f(x).
S_1 is the area enclosed by the x-axis, x = a and y = f(x);
S_2 is the area enclosed by the x-axis, x = b and y = f(x);
where a < b and 0 < S_2 < S_1.

The value of integral from a to b of f(x)dx is

Figure, described in words:
A Cartesian coordinate plane with horizontal x-axis and vertical y-axis intersecting at origin 0. A smooth curve labeled y = f(x) passes from below the negative x-axis, crosses below the origin, and continues into the fourth quadrant, then curves upward to cross the positive x-axis between values a and b, entering the first quadrant and continuing to increase. A vertical line segment extends downward from x = a on the positive x-axis to the curve, bounding a shaded region labeled S_1 below the x-axis and above the curve. A vertical line segment extends upward from x = b on the positive x-axis to the curve, bounding a shaded region labeled S_2 above the x-axis and below the curve.

A. S_1 + S_2
B. S_1 - S_2
C. S_2 - S_1
D. |S_1 - S_2|
E. 1/2 (S_1 + S_2)

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
